body.question: Give me every order in the database.

attempts.sql: SELECT orders.order_id, orders.customer_id, orders.ordered_at, orders.status, orders.ship_country, orders.carrier, orders.source, orders.subscription_id, orders.shipping_czk, orders.total_czk FROM orders

body.explanation: The query returned 1,000 orders dated 2023-10-09, but the result was cut short at 1,000 rows.

result.sql:
SELECT
  orders.order_id AS order_id,
  orders.customer_id AS customer_id,
  orders.ordered_at AS ordered_at,
  orders.status AS status,
  orders.ship_country AS ship_country,
  orders.carrier AS carrier,
  orders.source AS source,
  orders.subscription_id AS subscription_id,
  orders.shipping_czk AS shipping_czk,
  orders.total_czk AS total_czk
FROM orders AS orders
LIMIT 1000
